I can read some Japanese, but not much. I've figured out that you don't really need to know Japanese to use the app! It's pretty self explanitory, just click on the keyboard you want to use and it's that simple! I'm using a Simeji keyboard right now, and it's so adorable! To change the keyboard to English, search how to change simeji keyboare to english on YouTube, there are plenty of tutorials! Keep in mind that you cannot change the actual language in the app, just the language you want to type in. Well, you can change the app to Korean but I don't think that helps a lot of people lol! One last thing, the Simeji keyboard doesn't have autocorrect, so if you spell a word wrong or misclick, it won’t fix it for you, you have to go back. Overall, Simeji is my favorite app and I love it so much! There are so many options, and all of them are just so adorable! I'm using きらきらうさぎ right now and OMG SO CUTE!! Definitely five stars!!
